description.en: Returns a random integer in the given [min, max) range, using the match's own dedicated RNG (used by match logic such as clash-power rolls and foul checks, kept separate from the general-purpose CMND_RANDOM).
The random value in [min, max); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Roll a percentage chance using the match RNG to decide a foul
local faul_rand = CMND_BTL_GET_RAND(0, 101);
